name: B10-0090/2024 (ESN) – Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on women's rights in Iraq and a proposed change to Iraq's Personal Status Law, which it says would allow Sharia rules on marriage and legitimise child marriage. It also asks the European Union to tie development aid to Iraq to cooperation on taking back Iraqis who are staying in the European Union illegally, and to stop that aid if Iraq does not cooperate.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects women and girls in Iraq and European Union aid to Iraq.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and member state governments.
